paper.title: Leveraging recurrence in neural network wavefunctions for large-scale simulations of Heisenberg antiferromagnets on the triangular lattice
paper.authors: M. Schuyler Moss, Roeland Wiersema, Mohamed Hibat-Allah, Juan Carrasquilla, Roger G. Melko

results.system_description: 6x6 triangular lattice, periodic along both primitive vectors; J = 1; S = sigma/2; total Sz = 0
results.eligibility_evidence: Variational energy of the authors' RNN wavefunction for the L = 6 periodic cluster; other rows are quoted from the literature and excluded.
results.notes: Transcribed from the cited location of the versioned arXiv source and checked against the printed token; curator review pending. Parenthesized uncertainties are recorded as reported, with their meaning left unspecified unless the paper states it.

results.system_description: 12x12 triangular lattice, periodic along both primitive vectors; J = 1; S = sigma/2; total Sz = 0
results.source_location: Authors' data release github.com/mschuylermoss/HeisenbergRNN, commit d58a945cd4, file Triangular/final_plotting/plotting_data/final_energies_data_plotting.pkl, entry ['TriangularMS,periodicBC']['scale=4.0,rate=0.158,T=1.00'], L = 12 (energies, std errors); plotted in Fig. fig:energies_peri
results.eligibility_evidence: Variational energy per site of the authors' most accurate simulation (s = 4.0, r = 0.158; Tables tab:L=6, tab:vscores and tab:total-spin), plotted in fig:energies_peri and printed only in the data release named in the Code Availability section; zero-variance extrapolations are excluded.
results.notes: Rounded to one significant digit of the standard error, as in the paper's tables; the file holds E/N = -0.5493287510342069 with standard error 9.793047021398267e-05. The same entry gives the printed L = 6 value -0.5562(2), and its variances reproduce the V-scores of Table tab:vscores. The file also lists a variance; it is not recorded because it is not Var(H)/N.
